points.display_name: 柜内消防系统烟雾浓度数据
points.key: Inside cabinet fire system smoke concentration data
points.source_key: Inside cabinet fire system smoke concentration data
points.description: Inside cabinet fire system  smoke concentration data
points.definition:
Smoke concentration, measurement range: 0-2.00dB/m
Increase the actual value by 100 times, calculation method: actual smoke concentration value=smoke concentration data/100
For example, when the smoke concentration data is 15, it is 0.15 dB/m

points.display_name: 柜内消防系统温度数据
points.key: Inside cabinet fire system temp data
points.source_key: Inside cabinet fire system temp data
points.description: Inside cabinet fire system  temp data
points.definition:
Temperature data, measurement temperature range: -40 ℃ to+125 ℃
Data offset of 40, calculation method: actual temperature value=temperature data-40
For example, when the temperature data is 0: -40 ℃
When the temperature data is 40: 0 ℃
When the temperature data is 165: 125 ℃

points.display_name: 柜内消防系统一氧化碳数据
points.key: Inside cabinet fire system carbon monoxide data
points.source_key: Inside cabinet fire system carbon monoxide data
points.description: Inside cabinet fire system carbon monoxide data
points.definition:
Carbon monoxide concentration, measurement range: 0-2550ppm
Calculation method: Actual carbon monoxide concentration value=Carbon monoxide concentration data * 10
For example, when the carbon monoxide concentration data is 20, it is 200ppm
